facts.text: Through Franklin's 3+1 community college partnerships and Pathway Portal, students who earn an associate degree from a partner institution secure a reduced tuition rate of $298 per credit hour and free textbooks for bachelor's courses.

sources.title: College Partnership Program | Community Colleges | Franklin.edu
sources.quote: All community colleges that partner with Franklin to offer the Pathway Portal will secure a $298 tuition rate as well as free textbooks for bachelor's degree courses at Franklin
